title.rendered: UPDATED: Notice of Public Hearing on 2023-24 Budget – June 21, 2023

content.rendered:
UPDATE (June 14, 2023): For meeting agenda, please click here.

A public meeting of the Sherwood School District Board of Directors will be held on June 21, 2023 at 6:00 p.m. in the District Office Board Room, located at 21920 SW Sherwood Blvd., Sherwood, OR 97140. The purpose of this meeting is to discuss the budget for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 2023 as approved by the SSD Budget Committee. A summary of the budget is presented here.

A copy of the full budget document may be inspected or obtained at the SSD District Office between the hours of 8:00 AM and 4:00 PM, or at the link below. This budget is for an annual budget period.
